text: FolderFlag notifications update active folder modes, then update folder type and names for every row with the folder URI. Names include abbreviated/localized folder text and full path; special remote-folder flags can affect localization. Row name style also updates fullName for the scheduled ARIA label. Local-folder naming has its own override. This is a scoped UI synchronization contract, not a generic rename rule or live accessibility proof. No runtime tests.
title: A folder flag change refreshes every matching row name as well as its type
